text:
maya: Heads up — kicking off onboarding for meridian-11b (v1). Weights uploaded to s3://rwd-models/meridian/11b/v1/ — please confirm checksums. Quick note: HF tokenizer needs 2 custom tokens (<|meta|>, <|sep|>) that currently map to unknown tokens; may need to prepend overrides. starting perf runs after config fix.

ashwin: I'll validate the weights + run checksum. ETA ~30m.

dave: config.yaml from the onboarding PR is missing `sequence_length` and `pad_token`. CI validator throws: `ValidationError: pad_token not specified`. Repro snippet:
```yaml
model:
  name: meridian-11b
  dtype: fp16
  device: cuda
# missing pad_token, sequence_length
```

maya: thanks — adding pad_token `<|pad|>` and seq 2048 now.

ben: bench-bot scheduled a quick smoke on a single A10G for batch sizes 1/4/8. tagging infra for burst GPUs if we need more. @infra-bot can you confirm quota?

infra-bot: quota check OK, 2 spare A10G for a 2h window in us-west2.

bench-bot: run results (smoke, prompt len 64, sampling=greedy):
```
batch=1: p50=75ms p95=140ms tokens/s=140
batch=4: p50=110ms p95=220ms tokens/s=480
batch=8: p50=190ms p95=420ms tokens/s=880
```
Observation: KV-cache warm-up increases throughput after 2 tokens; try seq=128 for stable numbers.

ashwin: looks reasonable. Did you enable `prefill_cache=true` in runtime config? That explains the warmup.

bench-bot: added prefill_cache in run2, results:
```
batch=1: p50=68ms p95=120ms tokens/s=155
batch=4: p50=95ms p95=180ms tokens/s=520
batch=8: p50=160ms p95=350ms tokens/s=920
```

dave: tokenizer patch ready — small change to special token mapping and rescue unknown token merging. PR #412.

maya: dropped a quick eval set (50 prompts) — accuracy/regression looks ok but see occasional truncation when prompt ends with `<|sep|>` — might be tokenization boundary issue.

ben: can you share one failing example? I'll add to regression prompts.

maya: example: 'Summarize: A long list... <|sep|>' -> output truncates after sep. sending PM.

ashwin: I'll run full onboard bench tomorrow with 4x longer prompts and report perf + cost per 1k tokens. If infra ok, schedule dedicated run Fri morning.

dave: quick CR ping @maya @ashwin on PR 412 — merge after CI passes.

maya: ack, will do after bench stable numbers. :thumbsup:
